rule: The story world follows its historical chronology. Marion's player phone is a deliberately timeless modern gameplay device available in every story year.

photo_contract.storyDate: in-world date, not device technology date
photo_contract.visibility: gallery assets persist with the save
photo_contract.reuse: photos can be attached to later messages, memories and callbacks

generation.principle: Generate or capture photos from meaningful lived moments, not every scene.
generation.identity: must preserve canonical characters and current scene continuity
generation.surprise: photos may also arrive autonomously from characters when causally plausible
